messages:
maya: Heads up team — mini surprise at 3pm in the lounge for Sam. Two reasons: promo to Staff Engineer and engagement announced! :sparkles: :ring:

sam: wait what??!! that's today?? :sweat_smile:

oliver: congrats sam!! i'll bring sparkling water and a small bouquet.

people-ops: Event added to calendar: 3:00pm lounge. Please RSVP if you plan to attend.

calendar-bot: Invite link: https://calendar.example/e/2056789012

tessa: I'd vote for donuts + mini quiches. Any allergies?

maya: Donuts are great. Rami can pick up a vegan box if needed.

rami: On it. Also, sam, do you want photos taken or prefer low-key?

sam: low-key please. quick pics are fine.

oliver: banner idea: "Staff + Stuck in Love" (too corny?) :joy:

maya: Perfectly corny. bring it.

people-ops: Reminder: if bringing gifts, drop them at People Ops desk before 2:45pm to keep it a surprise.

tessa: I'll man the door at 2:55pm to usher Sam in.

maya: Cool. everyone else — try to be there by 2:55. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: you all are the worst but also the best. see you soon :)
